module: Code shared between runtime (audioForest.lua) and the editor: turns the objects of a Forest into a thinned cloud of audio nodes. Loaded with require('core/audioForest/audioForestCommon'). The algorithm: (1) a prepass that reads the forest items (in blocks) and computes volume and height per model (shape); (2) S/M/L classification by normalized volume (95th percentile) with possible override; (3) greedy thinning: keep an item and absorb all its neighbors within minNodeSpacing (20 m); (4) construction of a 3D KD-tree of the nodes.
usage:
local c = require('core/audioForest/audioForestCommon')
local cloud = c.buildNodeCloudFromForest(forestObj, toolState, nil, {})
-- cloud.nodeCount, cloud.kdNodes ...
notes: Default config (defaultCfg): minNodeSpacing 20 m, thinningOuterRadiusMul 1.5, nodeHeightBlend 0.5, classT0 1/3, classT1 2/3, volumeClassPercentile 0.95, pitchNormPercentile 0.95.
An item's volume is the volume of its bounding box multiplied by its scale.
Only these functions are exported; the rest (thinning priority queue, emptyCloud, etc.) is local.

getItemVolume.desc: Volume (m³) of a forest item's bounding box, multiplied by its scale. Returns 0 without a box.

computeDefaultClassFromNormVol.desc: Converts a normalized volume [0..1] into a size class: 1 below t0, 2 below t1, otherwise 3.

classT1.desc: Threshold 2/3, 2/3 by default (swapped with t0 if t0 > t1)

startRuntimePrepass.desc: Prepares the state of an incremental prepass: fetches all forest items (forestObj:getData():getItems()).

st.desc: Tool state; uses includeByShape (an absent model or true is included, false is excluded)

returns.desc: Prepass state {all, allCount, i, includeByShape, shapeVol, shapeMaxZ, includedItem, includedShape, volList, volN, itemCount, isReady}

stepRuntimePrepass.desc: Processes up to maxSteps prepass items: keeps the included items and measures the volume and max height once per model. Sets isReady to true when all items have been seen.

maxSteps.desc: Maximum number of items per call, 10000 by default

returns.desc: true when the prepass is finished

buildNodeCloudFromForest.desc: Builds the audio node cloud. Finishes the prepass if needed, classifies the models, thins the items and builds a KD-tree (kdtreepoint3d). Returns an empty cloud (nodeCount 0) if there are no included items.

cfg.desc: Configuration (defaultCfg keys, as well as pitchDensityPercentile)

opts.desc: Options: prepass (prepass already done), shapeToRow + includeEditorFields (adds nodeTypeRow and nodeClassId for the editor)

returns.desc: {minNodeSpacing, nodeCount, nodeX, nodeY, nodeZ, nodeDepth, nodeAvgNormVol, nodeSourceCount, pitchDensityInv, nodeTypeRow, nodeClassId, kdNodes}
